primary_method.title: TETRA: a web-service and a stand-alone program for the analysis and comparison of tetranucleotide usage patterns in DNA sequences
primary_method.facts_used: double-stranded sequence composition, all256 tetranucleotide words, Markov expected frequencies/z-score/Pearson method
primary_method.retrieval_limitations: Primary article surfaced with full methods in web search. Subsequent direct PMC open showed bot check; BMC/EuropePMC direct follow-up transport failed. No new full-text PDF/source download claimed.

implementation_scope: Independent exact legal-window counts, per-record aggregation, both strands/256 ordered words. Not bitwise pyani0.2.12 compatible; complete finite variance profile eligibility explicitly defined locally.
user_method_authorization: 按标准 TETRA 方法修正，并单独校准关联阈值（推荐）
calibration: Pending actual independently curated/labeled/locked host dataset with group-disjoint holdout. Native self/fragment controls and numerical calibration CLI examples are not known-host validation.
